mapper.sql: form_code, form_name, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, category, content_html, field_schema, created_by, created_by_nm
mapper.select: SELECT FROM eap_form_config ORDER BY sort_order, form_code
SELECT FROM eap_form_config WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order, form_code
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(split_part(form_code, '-', 2) AS INTEGER)), 0) + 1 FROM eap_form_config WHERE form_code ~ ('^' || #{year} || '-[0-9]+$')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eap_form_config ( form_code, form_name, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, category, content_html, created_by, created_by_nm, field_schema ) VALUES ( #{formCode}, TRIM(#{body.formName}), COALESCE(#{body.enabled}, TRUE), COALESCE(#{body.sortOrder}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.category}), ''), '기타문서'), #{body.contentHtml}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.createdBy}), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.createdByNm}), ''), #{body.fieldSchema} )
mapper.update: UPDATE eap_form_config SET form_name = TRIM(#{body.formName}), enabled = COALESCE(#{body.enabled}, enabled), sort_order = COALESCE(#{body.sortOrder}, sort_order), category = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.category}), ''), category), content_html = #{body.contentHtml}, field_schema = #{body.fieldSchema}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE form_code = #{formCode}
